tools.name: search_builders
tools.description: Find NSW builders by name, ABN, ACN or licence number, optionally within a postcode. Resolve the legal entity before reading its record. Try the legal company name if a trading name misses.

tools.name: get_builder_risk
tools.description: Read one builder's public identity, licences, company status and stored source flags. Facts only: flags are not a safety rating, and missing records are not a clearance. Use get_builder_coverage for check dates and gaps.

tools.name: get_builder_timeline
tools.description: Read the first 50 public timeline events, newest event date first. Each event retains its source, occurrence/detection dates and archive flag. Use get_builder_changes to page further; the public API holds at most 500 timeline rows in this response.

tools.name: get_builder_coverage
tools.description: Read public per-source check states, result details, last attempt/success dates, next due dates and source URLs. This reads recorded state; it does not rerun checks or enable monitoring. Unchecked, stale and unavailable are gaps, not clear results.

tools.name: get_builder_changes
tools.description: Page the public dated event timeline, newest event date first. This is recorded history, not private monitoring notifications or a since-last-run feed. Default 25, maximum 100 events. Pass nextCursor unchanged; restart without a cursor if the timeline changed. Public API response is capped at 500 ro

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_builders" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Australian (currently NSW) builders, contractors and building companies by name; optionally filter by postcode. Returns matching entities with their licence status and a slug to pass to get_builder_risk / get_builder_timeline. Example: query='Acme Building' → '- Acme Building Pty Ltd (Current" → after: "Find NSW builders by name, ABN, ACN or licence number, optionally within a postcode. Resolve the legal entity before reading its record. Try the legal company name if a trading name misses."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
